result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both show all five November Sundays with a name and a clearly outlined Swap button on each upcoming row, and both highlight the next Sunday. B looks more finished: it is framed as a card and lists each person's cake (where A just repeats the word 'Cake'), and its title says it is for the village hall. B loses a little because its 'Done' label is shaped like a button but does nothing, and its stacked 'NOV SUN / 1' dates are slightly harder to scan than A's large day numbers. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both pages show all five November Sundays with a named person and an outlined Swap button on each row, and both highlight the coming Sunday and grey out the one already past. A says which cake each person is bringing, while B just repeats "Cake" as a filler subtitle, which looks half-done. A's dates stack awkwardly ("NOV SUN" over the number), and B's large day numbers are easier to read at a glance, but that isn't enough to outweigh B's filler text.
